{"metadata":{"description":"论衡（lunheng-article-pipeline）DeepSeek Harness bundle 插件（DSH 适配版）","id":"gh:1336782782","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"lunheng-article-pipeline-dsh","slug":"zuoyunlai/lunheng-article-pipeline-dsh","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"论衡（lunheng-article-pipeline）DeepSeek Harness bundle 插件（DSH 适配版）"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Lunheng (lunheng-article-pipeline) — a DeepSeek Harness bundle for multi-agent long-form writing"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 🌐 **English** (this file) ｜ 中文 ｜ Español ｜ Português ｜ हिन्दी"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 版本：v19.27.16（DSH bundle：package.json + cordis.patch.yml + lib/index.js）"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers **two on-demand agent skills**:
> - `lunheng-articl"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"e-pipeline` — the main 9-role pipeline (T1–T9, see below).
> - `lunheng-commands` — a thin wrapper e"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"xposing 13 `/lunheng-*` slash commands (draft / resume / cite / audit / journal / ppt / history / ro"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"llback / status / stats / gate / abort / help).
>     No new role, no new M-gate item; see `skills/l"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"unheng-commands/SKILL.md`.
>
> The main skill turns long-form production — academic papers, industry"},{"id":"p5s6","text":" analysis, business commentary, and long-form articles — into a **9-role pipeline with a human in th"},{"id":"p5s7","text":", business commentary, and long-form articles — into a **9-role pipeline with a human in the loop**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What this is"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Lunheng is a writing pipeline, not a text generator. It splits a long-form deliverable into 9 indepe"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ndent roles (T1–T9) across 6 phases, orchestrated with DSH `subagent` calls, and produces output wit"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"h an evidence base, counter-argument review, independent audit, and human checkpoints."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The nine roles are independent and interchangeable with nothing else: T1 literature scout, T2 data s"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"cout, T3 case scout, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer (execute"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"d by the coordinator itself), T9 peer reviewer."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## When to use it"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- You need a long-form piece (over 2000 characters) that has to hold up under scrutiny, and you can "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"wait several hours (the pipeline deliberately gives **no hour range** — see `skills/lunheng-article-"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"pipeline/SKILL.md` §边界).
- The topic involves facts, figures, or multiple viewpoints, so it needs an"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" evidence base rather than opinion only.
- You want human checkpoints: confirm the outline before dr"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"afting, and review the final draft."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## When not to use it"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Lunheng actively collects **published** evidence and integrates evidence you supply. It cannot produ"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ce the following on its own; supply the material first, or use another tool:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Item | Content |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Literature cards `[Lxx]` | Published sources with A/B/C confidence grading and a pioneer list for "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"originality checks |
| Data cards `[Dxx]` | Figures with source, year, freshness grading, trust leve"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"l, and conflicting figures shown side by side |
| Case cards `[Cxx]` | Event structure (who/when/wha"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"t/each side's account), or an explicit `[C-空]` empty marker |
| Analysis outline | Argument thread, "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"claim-to-evidence mapping, counter-argument plan, load-bearing evidence list |
| Drafts | Successive"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" versions with AI-trace cleanup, each independent writer run |
| Review reports | Critical report (C"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"1–C7), audit report (G0–G14), peer-review report (6 dimensions + journal matching), AI-trace report "},{"id":"p16s8","text":"|
| Final deliverables | `final/定稿.md`, figures, evidence bundle, delivery notes, M-gate report |
| "},{"id":"p16s9","text":"DSH integration (bundle install) | Four **read-only** tools — `lunheng_m_gate` (M-gate mechanical pr"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"e-check), `lunheng_char_count` (pure Chinese-character count), `lunheng_handoff_check` (handoff-repo"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"rt shape / version / pairs / agents-log verification at the role-handoff boundary), and `lunheng_eth"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"ics_sanitize` (ethics de-identification: masks IDs / phones / e-mails / bank cards / person names / "},{"id":"p16s13","text":"place names in interview transcripts and field notes; returns the masked text so the caller decides "},{"id":"p16s14","text":"where to write it; v18.60.1); if your session does not expose them, call the same scripts with `pwsh"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"` as before (same source of truth). Human commands `/lunheng-status` (reads `run/<project>/status.md"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"`; produces no model message) and `/lunheng-stats` (cross-project telemetry dashboard; spawns the ho"},{"id":"p16s17","text":"st-process `scripts/lunheng-stats.mjs` with `--json` whitelisted only; output truncated to 8000 char"},{"id":"p16s18","text":"s; produces no model message). **Mechanism-file write protection**: a global guard rejects `write`/`"},{"id":"p16s19","text":"edit`-style tool calls that target the skill package, so a session cannot quietly rewrite the pipeli"},{"id":"p16s20","text":"ne's own rules. Boundary, stated plainly: the guard only sees **tool calls** — `pwsh` and any subp ["},{"id":"p16s21","text":"own rules. Boundary, stated plainly: the guard only sees **tool calls** — `pwsh` and any subp [长行截断]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Pipeline overview"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Triangular evidence base** (`[L]` + `[D]` + `[C]`) — every claim must map to literature, data, and"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" (for event claims) case evidence. **Independent audit** — the auditor never edits; it reports. **Fo"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ur human checkpoints** — Phase 0, 2.5, 3.5, and 5."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Item | Requirement |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| DSH (product version) | `dsh` CLI available; the bundle's `- insert:` incremental patch rows need "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"**DSH 5.5.0+ product release** — note: `dsh` ships as two parallel version lines, a **product releas"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"e line** (semver, e.g. `5.5.0`) and the **npm package line** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (prerelease tags, e."},{"id":"p22s4","text":"g. `0.1.7-rc.2`); they are **not** interchangeable |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (npm package version) | `>"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0` declared in `peerDependencies`; **CI exercises `0.1.7-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`** ("},{"id":"p22s6","text":"the `install-smoke` matrix in `ci.yml`); other releases inside the range (e.g. `0.2.0-rc.x`, `0.1.3`"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"–`0.1.6`) are **declared, not verified** |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` (DSH runtime floor; see"},{"id":"p22s8","text":" `engines` in `package.json`) |
| pnpm | Required by install/uninstall (`dsh plugin` delegates to pn"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"pm) |
| Platform | Windows / macOS / Linux (the scripts have zero dependencies and run cross-platfor"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"|
| Platform | Windows / macOS / Linux (the scripts have zero dependencies and run cross-platform) |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Chinese-first.** Role prompts, deliverables, file names, and workflows default to Chinese.
- **N"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"o network verification by default.** Numeric-level source checks often remain "pending manual review"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"" because paywalled and offline sources cannot be fetched.
- **Audit independence has a cost.** A fu"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ll run dispatches 15+ subagents; most token spend is context reads, not generation.
- **M-gate false"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" positives are possible.** A script can flag a legitimate construct; the finalizer must record `scri"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"pt_exit_raw` and justify the `exit` verdict rather than editing the document to force exit 0.
- **No"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"t a substitute for peer review.** The T9 report is a pre-submission simulation only."}],"truncated":true}
